name: M5.Binomial.signed_product_split
statement: ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ s ∈ S, f s = 1 ∨ f s = -1) → M5.Binomial.signedProduct S f = (1 - Polynomial.X) ^ M5.Binomial.negativeCount S f * (1 + Polynomial.X) ^ (S.card - M5.Binomial.negativeCount S f)
guidance: Split product with Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not at predicate f s=-1. On negative filter each factor is 1-X; on complement supplied sign hypothesis makes each factor 1+X. Products of constants are powers, and Finset.card_filter_not gives complement count as S.card-negativeCount. Empty S is included. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.
